test_cases.name: phase4-proc-create-task
test_cases.expected: Task created WITHOUT --wait (create-then-poll); task_id returned in payload.id; then poll show-task until SUCCEEDED with a progress heartbeat (see references/custom-operator/custom-operator-workflow.md §Progress Feedback); user log shows 'Processed N items, success N, failed 0' (legacy Chinese '共处理 N 项，成功 N，失败 0' also OK). Input datasets follow the platform's TWO data-source categories: 空间资产-数据 (BUILD_IN_ASSET — ① create dataset asset: create-asset type=dataset + create-version + update-version RELEASE; ② reuse existing assets with full asset fields) and OBS存储 (③ UDF_OBS_ASSET — dataset_configs entry = {"obs_path":"...","dataset_type":"UDF_OBS_ASSET"}, NO asset fields, NO dataset asset created or referenced; **obs_path bucket MUST equal the workspace-bound bucket = default_obs_path bucket from cloudrobo workspace current, other OBS buckets rejected & re-asked**). MULTIPLE data sources (≤10) MUST be merged into ONE task: N entries in the single dataset_configs array, exactly one create-task (never one task per dataset; batch per-dataset split only on explicit user request + confirmation); operator log shows 'Resolved N datasets'. CANCEL/RE-ISSUE after a task was created: MUST first confirm deletion of the old task (delete-task + show-task = DELETED) before creating a new one — never leave an orphaned running task (see §Phase Boundaries 4.11 / S12). Image asset --name must equal the dialogue-confirmed operator name (verify via show-asset). Re-run after a FAILED verification (Mode A rebuild): re-submission branch create-version+update-asset (never re-create-asset) + fresh output_name + verified asset linkage (HTTP 500 on re-run create-task = stale algorithm linkage → see §Failure Analysis Guide pattern 5d)

test_cases.command: du -sh ${DATA_DIR} && find ${DATA_DIR} -type f | wc -l && python3 -c "from obs import ObsClient; import os; c=ObsClient(access_key_id=os.environ['HUAWEI_CLOUD_AK'], secret_access_key=os.environ['HUAWEI_CLOUD_SK'], server='https://obs.${REGION}.myhuaweicloud.com'); [c.putFile('${OBS_BUCKET}', f'${OBS_PREFIX}/{os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,f),"${DATA_DIR}").replace(os.sep,"/")}', os.path.join(r,f)) for r,d,fs in os.walk('${DATA_DIR}') for f in fs if not f.endswith(('.upload_record','.upload_tmp'))]"
test_cases.expected: Large dataset (> 50 files / > 50MB) uploaded with the concurrent sharded approach per references/custom-operator/custom-operator-workflow.md §OBS Upload Guide (never serial-walks): job sized first (du -sh + find | wc -l), ~25 req/s with 4 procs x 16 threads, progress heartbeat shown, then verified by object-count parity (listObjects total == local file count); upload confirmed with the customer first

notes: Structure: test_cases[] contains proc/eval basics, operator inputs and pipeline checks, plus TC-50..TC-71 for custom-operator onboarding; each case is executed by scripts/test-cli-commands.sh.
Read-only cases (type=read) run automatically when their required environment variables are available.
Mutation cases (type=mutation) require explicit user confirmation (CONFIRM_MUTATIONS=1); they are skipped by default.
TC-03 checks ordering/pagination; TC-03a independently checks algorithm-name filtering when ALGO_NAME is set. Existing test IDs are kept stable.
Set TASK_ID to run proc-task-specific tests (TC-04, TC-07 to TC-13, TC-16 to TC-19a, TC-21, TC-28b); set PREFIX for TC-19 (get-frames) and JOB_NAME for TC-19a/TC-23b (get-events).
Set TASK_CONFIG to run TC-06 (create-task); set TIMESTAMP for the copy tests (TC-08, TC-23a).
Set TASK_CONFIG_WITH_INPUTS to run TC-33 (create-task with operator inputs; copy the complete ext_metadata.inputs[] element from the current operator query and set only url_path).
Set EVAL_TASK_ID to run eval-task-specific tests (TC-23, TC-23a, TC-23b, TC-25 to TC-29, TC-32).
Set EVAL_TASK_CONFIG to run TC-24 (eval create-task).
Pipeline test TC-31 requires a SUCCEEDED proc-task and its target_path (set as the eval task's top-level dataset_path).
Dataset tasks do NOT support restart; TC-08 validates copy-task instead.

Custom-operator onboarding tests (TC-50+) cover deploy-mode Phase 0 asset detection, Mode A build/push, Mode B 空间资产-算法 preset registration (OBS算法 skips Phase 3 — no assets), Phase 4 dataset source (create-dataset + RELEASE), runtime verification and failure analysis; mutation cases require explicit user confirmation.
